item.title: Raoul Moat And The Seven Day Manhunt That Gripped Britain
item.description: In July 2010, Raoul Moat went on the run after shooting his ex-girlfriend Samantha Stobbart, killing her new partner Chris Brown, and seriously wounding police officer David Rathband. A huge armed operation followed across Northumberland, ending after a six-hour standoff in Rothbury when Moat died by suicide.

item.title: The Parents Convicted In The Death Of Their Newborn Daughter
item.description: Two-week-old Caliyah McNabb was reported missing from her Georgia home in October 2017, but investigators soon discovered she had been killed and left in nearby woods. Her parents, Christopher McNabb and Cortney Bell, were convicted in 2019. McNabb received life without parole, while Bell's murder conviction was later dismissed on appeal and her remaining conviction was upheld.
